caption: The drawing features a single wooden rocking chair positioned slightly angled to the left, set against a plain, light beige background. The chair is composed of light brown wood and includes several distinct features: thin, evenly spaced vertical slats on the backrest, a slightly curved top rail, and a solid, flat seat. The arms of the chair are supported by additional vertical and diagonal slats, with the right arm featuring an extended, flat writing surface attached to its side, which projects forward in an irregular shape. The chair stands on two curved rockers, each connected by angled legs and horizontal support rods. The overall appearance of the chair is simple and unembellished, with the wood grain and structural details clearly rendered.
title: Rocking Chair
